description: Source code for PermissionsCenterFragment, a UI fragment managing runtime permissions for Location, Media, and SMS in an Android app. It provides UI elements for permissions status display, request actions, and optional SMS opt-in, integrating with PermissionsManager.

classes.name: PermissionsCenterFragment
classes.description: A Fragment that displays and manages runtime permissions for Location, Media, and SMS, including UI components for status display, permission requests, app settings navigation, and SMS opt-in.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the fragment, sets options menu availability.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Initializes UI components, permissions manager, and request launcher; sets up event handlers; binds permission states to views.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles menu item selections, including navigation to help fragment.

methods.name: setupActions
methods.description: Sets click listeners for permission action buttons, manages permission requests and app settings navigation, handles SMS opt-in logic.

methods.name: bindStates
methods.description: Updates UI elements to reflect current permission statuses, including status text, button labels, and SMS opt-in state.
